indexes.name: card_printings_finish_key_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX card_printings_finish_key_idx ON public.card_printings USING btree (finish_key)

indexes.name: card_prints_gv_id_trgm_idx
indexes.comment: Bounds PostgREST gv_id ILIKE lookups used by canonical image routing and collector search.
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX card_prints_gv_id_trgm_idx ON public.card_prints USING gin (gv_id gin_trgm_ops) WHERE (gv_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: market_price_qualification_run_publish_id_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX market_price_qualification_run_publish_id_idx ON public.market_price_qualification_decisions USING btree (run_id, id) WHERE ((eligible = true) AND (decision = 'publish'::text) AND (publication_lane = 'current'::text))

indexes.name: tcgcsv_source_artifacts_sync_run_kind_latest_idx
indexes.comment: Bounds publication provenance lookup to one TCGCSV source run and artifact kind while retaining the latest artifact hash as index-only evidence.
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX tcgcsv_source_artifacts_sync_run_kind_latest_idx ON public.tcgcsv_source_artifacts USING btree (sync_run_id, artifact_kind, created_at DESC, id DESC) INCLUDE (sha256)

pricing_view.comment: Retired compatibility surface. Production V1 clients must use get_market_pricing_read_model_v1; this view intentionally returns zero rows.

search_function.comment: PRINT_IDENTITY_SEARCH_BOUNDED_CANDIDATES_V1. Preserves V1 output and release visibility while bounding high-priority names and skipping lower-ranked candidate families only after the requested page is satisfied.

visibility_function.comment: CATALOG_PARENT_VISIBILITY_DIRECT_V1. Equivalent fail-closed Pokemon/public/signed-in release rule resolved without nested helper calls.

operations_constraint.comment: Private operations severity vocabulary: critical=SEV-1, high=SEV-2, warning=SEV-3, info=successful or forecast notice.
